title: S key double-mapped: opens settings panel AND fires the QoS Set_Lane(Standard) intent in the same frame
evidence:
case .S:
			append(out, Intent(Toggle_Settings{}))
--- (phase-2, pre-existing, still live when phase2_blocked is false) ---
		case .S:
			append(out, Intent(Set_Lane{lane = pp.LANE_STANDARD}))
--- (exec.odin:193) ---
	case Set_Lane:
		// the E/S/B lane keys (gated on the selection + the class index)
		if inp.sel_pipe >= 0 && u32(inp.sel_class) < u32(len(inp.cat.packet_types)) {
detail: With a pipe selected, one S press emits both intents: the QoS Standard-lane assignment lands AND the modal settings panel opens, pausing the run. The QoS panel still advertises "[1/2 + E/S/B]". Regresses the shipped 5.8 keyboard surface; contradicts Acceptance 1 "input parity holds".
recommended_fix: Choose a non-colliding settings hotkey (or gate S->Toggle_Settings on no pipe selected / QoS idle), and keep the QoS panel label in sync with whichever binding survives.

title: Touch row taps can only step UI scale UP — no touch path emits delta -1, so 150% is a one-way ratchet
evidence:
case rnd.SETTINGS_ROW_SCALE:
		step := delta
		if step == 0 { step = 1 }
		nxt := i32(app.a11y.scale_step) + step
		nxt = clamp(nxt, 0, UI_SCALE_COUNT - 1)
--- (settings_click row tap) ---
				effect_settings_adjust(app.input.user, &app.input, i32(row), 0)
detail: The touch surface (chip+row taps, flagged in the briefing for verification) always passes delta 0, which becomes +1 and clamps at 150% — unlike the palette row it never wraps. A touch-only player cannot return to 100%/125%. Guard 3: panel must be operable on touch.
recommended_fix: Make the scale row wrap on activate (nxt mod UI_SCALE_COUNT), or add - / + sub-targets in the row hit-test so touch can step both directions.

title: QoS panel scaling is partial: action slot 1, preset chips, and nudge rects use unscaled geometry while the panel/rows scale
detail: qos_panel_rect/qos_row_y scale via hud() but these rects do not; at x1.25/x1.50 the buttons/chips misalign inside taller rows and cluster left of the widened panel. Contradicts Deliverable 3 ("chrome stays legible at each step") and the PR claim that hud() threads through the QoS panel.
recommended_fix: Route the remaining qos_*_rect x/w/h math through rnd.hud/hud_f so the editor controls scale with the rest of the panel (draw + hit-test single source).

title: a11y chip shows no reduced-motion indicator: motion-only active state still reads "A11Y SETTINGS (S)"
evidence:
scaled := v.ui_scale > 1.001 || v.palette.mode != .Off || v.reduced_motion
---
	case:         return "A11Y: 125%+" if v.ui_scale > 1.001 else "A11Y SETTINGS (S)"
detail: settings_chip_rect treats reduced_motion as an active mode (active background), but a11y_chip_text only summarizes palette/scale; with reduced-motion alone the chip text reads as fully inactive. Minor status-readout inconsistency on the a11y surface.
recommended_fix: Include a reduced-motion token in a11y_chip_text (e.g. "A11Y: RM" / append "+RM") so every active mode is summarized on the chip.
